distribution.narrative: Mainland China is confirmed by 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) (Heilongjiang, Jilin and Liaoning). Beaver & Liu (2010) separately treated the historical Taiwan attribution as doubtful, noting a northeastern Palaearctic species and a Taiwan report likely based on Shiraki material. Taiwan is therefore retained as Questionable and is not added to the current distribution summary.

host_note: Current hosts Picea koraiensis and Pinus koraiensis are supported by 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015). Beaver & Liu (2010) provides no host evidence for the doubtful Taiwan record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Hylurgops interstitialis (Chapuis, 1876).
